sentences.text:
VERSUS  STATE OF RAJASTHAN & ANR. Respondent(s)
 O R D E R Leave granted.

The appellant seeks suspension of sentence in relation to the conviction for the offences punishable under Sections 363, 366 and 376 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and Sections 3 and 4 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012 (for short, POCSO Act).

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The appellant was awarded rigorous imprisonment for a period of 10 years by the Trial Court.

Subsequently, during the pendency of his appeal against the said order of conviction, the High Court was pleased to dismiss his application seeking the suspension of sentence during the pendency of his appeal.
We have heard the learned counsel appearing for the parties.

Admittedly, out of the sentence of rigorous imprisonment for a period of 10 years awarded by the Trial Court for the offences punishable under sections 3 and 4 of the POCSO Act, the appellant has already undergone incarceration for a period of seven years and five months, with remission.
Taking note of the above position, we are inclined to suspend the sentence awarded to the appellant.

Accordingly, the impugned order is set aside and the sentence of the appellant is suspended, and he is granted bail, during the pendency of his appeal pending before the High Court, on the terms and conditions to the satisfaction of the concerned Trial Court.
The appeal stands allowed accordingly.
Pending application(s), if any, shall stand disposed of.
[ M . M . S U N D R E S H ]
.. J. [NONGMEIKAPAM KOTISWAR SINGH] NEW DELHI;
